Serengeti Kati Kati Tented Camp
Serengeti National Park
Immerse yourself in nature
at the bushcamp, Serengeti Kati kati tented Camp
Serengeti Kati Kati is a mobile camp strategically situated in central Serengeti, ideal for exploring the extensive Serengeti plains. The camp offers comfortable accommodation together with the unique opportunity to enjoy a real safari experience on a camp. In its comfortable tents one will feel completely immersed in the surroundings and one can enjoy the rich animal life and vegetation of the area.
An original form of accommodation which resembles the old camps of the first explorers in Africa, with all the commodities of today.
Located a two hour drive along a panoramic route from the Olduvai Museum and the river Grumeti, two of the indispensable visits for all travellers to Tanzania.

The camp has been designed to cause a minimum impact on the environment. All of the infrastructure is mobile and the philosophy of the company is not to leave anything behind.

Great camp among the wild animals
JOPHAN
UPPSALA, SWEDEN
We slept here for three nights. There is a strict ban on leaving the tent by yourself after sunset, and it’s easy to understand why. In the night, buffalos, hyenas and other animals prowl the camp. A fantastic experience. The food is good and plentiful, the beds are good.
Read more
We offer once in a lifetime
Experiences
Hot Air Balloon
Start the day on a high note by soaring above the plains in a hot-air balloon. As the sun rises, watch the herds of elephants from above and admire the unspoilt landscape.
Hot-air balloon rides are at an additional cost and are weather dependent.
The flight length varies between 50 to 90 minutes, all depending on the weather conditions. Bush breakfast after landing.
Sundowner
In a beautiful landscape, enjoy an appetizer and cocktail at the end of the day.
Camp Fire
One of the safari highlights is sitting around the camp fire, listening to the sounds of the wild, watching the sun go down and watching the never-ending sky.
Let nature inspire you
The camp has two dining tents where meals are served. In the evening, in the proximity of the dining-room tents, a camp fire is lit around which guests can enjoy an appetizer before dinner.

Kati Kati Tented Lodge
A mobile camp located in central Serengeti and strategically situated to cover the extensive Serengeti plains. Serengeti Kati Kati is a two hour drive along a panoramic route from the Olduvai Museum and the river Grumeti.
North charters companies flies to and from Arusha to different airstrips in Serengeti on a daily basis, approximately 50 min flight. Also contects with flights to and from Zanzibar and other national parks.
Nearest airstrip: Seronera Airstrip 40 minutes away.
Depending on the time of the allocation of the camp it takes approximately 5-10 hours, from Arusha.

Be a privileged spectator
from this Tented Lodge on the shores of Lake Burunge
Featuring 48 rooms, each offering breathtaking views of Lake Burunge and Tarangire National Park, our lodge is designed to provide a unique and immersive experience. The rooms, elevated on platforms, come in a range of configurations: 30 superior suites, 4 family units (each consisting of two interconnected rooms) and 10 well-appointed bungalows. All rooms have en-suite facilities, air conditioning and a fan.
Each bungalow includes one king bed (which can be converted into two twin beds) and one queen bed. These rooms have been designed to ensure a comfortable stay for families and groups.
To enhance your overall experience, the lodge will be complemented by a well-appointed main area. This space will serve as a hub for relaxation and enjoyment, housing lounges, a restaurant and a refreshing 25 m x 8 m swimming pool.

Opened in 2026, Burunge Baobab North Lodge brings an authentic safari camp experience into a new era of modern comfort. Its 30 Superior Suite rooms ground level each looking out over Lake Burunge and Tarangire National Park. Twenty are Superior Suite Double/Twin rooms, and ten are arranged as five Family Interconnecting Units, making the lodge just as right for couples as it is for families and groups. Every suite has air conditioning, a private verandah and generous space to unwind after a day in the parks.
At the heart of the lodge is a well-appointed mess area with lounges, a restaurant and a 40-metre swimming pool: the natural gathering place for slow mornings, lazy afternoons and sunsets over the lake.

The lounge and dining area at Burunge Baobab North is a showpiece of design, blending elegance with natural beauty. Set under a thatched roof on an elevated wooden platform, it opens onto a 360° panorama of Lake Burunge and the untouched bush beyond. Breakfast and dinner are served on the outdoor terrace when the weather allows, with wildlife and the wilderness at dusk all around, while lunch is available throughout the day beside the 40-metre pool on the shores of the lake. Soft drinks, local beers and house wines are included; premium wines and imported spirits are available at an additional charge.

It is just 20 minutes from both the park s main entrance and the Sangaiwe gate, and because the lodge sits on private land, walks and time outdoors carry no park fees.
Scheduled and charter flights connect Arusha with the Manyara airstrip daily, in about 25 minutes. Guests can also fly into the Kuro and Makumire airstrips inside Tarangire National Park, with onward connections to the Serengeti and Zanzibar.

About
Tanganyika Wildnerness Camps
In love with wild nature
IN LOVE WITH TANZANIA
At Tanganyika Wilderness Camps we are in love with Tanzania.
The country captivates us for its beauty and people, but especially the way in which you can live the wildlife, immersing yourself directly in them in the camps or in accommodation completely in the wild.
We want to offer this experience to travellers and add the necessary to make it perfect, adapting it not only for those who want a premium and relaxing version of the country as for those who are more adventurous in search of authenticity and emotions.
Lodgings - Experiences - Safaris
All we offer our customers
At Tanganyika Wilderness Camps we currently have a collection of unique properties chosen the length and breadth of the Tanzanian geography for their exceptional surroundings.
Not only have our lodges been conceived to offer the maximum comfort but also our mobile camps.  With the exact amount of luxury and comfort so as not to diminish the sensation of adventure to the experience.
Our safaris have also been carefully designed to meet the conditions, in a concrete number of days and selected experiences, the essence of Tanzania in its different aspects.  And, above all, so that you don’t leave with the sensation of having left something to see or live.

African hospitality – Spanish passion
TWC is a Tanzanian-Spanish company.  A fusion which tries to take the best of the two cultures:  the welcoming hospitality of the Tanzanians and the Spanish capacity to enjoy to the full each moment.
Hospitality and passion are two standards which always guide us when we prepare our offer: from the care of the catering in our accommodation or the exclusive attention of our guests to the parallel activities and planning of our safaris.
